candidate_layout_unknown.description: No candidate projection: the recognition pack declares no candidate layout with the requested ID.

candidate_feature_failed.description: No candidate projection: a feature's target could not be evaluated or measured; the recognition error travels as the cause.

candidate_feature_provider_missing.description: No candidate projection: a feature's target needs an OCR or NN provider the evaluator was built without.

candidate_samples_unavailable.description: No candidate projection: the frames given do not match the layout's required sample frames.

candidate_sample_geometry_changed.description: No candidate projection: a sample frame's geometry differs within the transaction.

candidate_sample_record_failed.description: No candidate projection: recording a candidate sample evaluation failed.

candidate_search_incomplete.description: The anchor search of a repeated_anchor candidate layout reached its time limit (timeout_ms, 5000) before it had scored every row of the anchor's search region; count is the number of positions that had passed the threshold and the relative color check by then. No partial candidate set is returned, so the projection, and the select step or observation that asked for it, fails. operation, optional, is the caller's location; A2d left the callers' failure detail as text, so none adds it yet.

candidate_search_repeated_anchor.description: Enumerating the anchor matches of a repeated_anchor candidate layout (SceneEvaluation::evaluate_target_all).
